info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM and eSIM Status Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for users to access the current statuses of both SIM and eSIM cards. This API caters to telecom service providers and developers working on mobile solutions, enabling them to efficiently fetch important status information. By querying this endpoint, consumers can monitor available services, troubleshoot issues, and ensure optimal connectivity for their end-users. Use cases typically include customer support tools and management dashboards that track SIM and eSIM performance.

get.description: This operation fetches the current status of the eSIM, including details about activation and provisioning. It provides necessary insights for managing eSIM functionalities effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters necessary to obtain the status of the eSIM, including any specific identifiers or attributes required by the service.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current eSIM status.
